articles.summary: Woking, UK, April 7, 2026 – Linde (Nasdaq: LIN) will release its first quarter 2026 financial results by 06:00 EDT/midday CEST on Friday, May 1, 2026. The Company will host and webcast its conference call at 09:00 EDT/15:00 CEST, which will be available to the public and the media in listen-only mode.
articles.title: Linde Announces First Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call Schedule
